details: Ledger, the French crypto hardware wallet manufacturer, has reportedly postponed its anticipated U.S. Initial Public Offering (IPO). The decision comes as the company reassesses its plans due to volatile market conditions and a reduced investor appetite for crypto-related IPOs.
title: Ledger Shelves IPO Amid Unfavorable Crypto Market Conditions

details: Bloomberg's senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas reported that since March, the Bitcoin spot ETF (IBIT) has significantly outperformed the gold ETF (GLD), leading by 33 percentage points. During this period, IBIT attracted $4.2 billion in net inflows, while GLD experienced $9 billion in net outflows, marking a $13 billion difference in capital flow between the two.
title: Bitcoin ETF IBIT Outperforms Gold ETF GLD by 33% Since March

details: Bitcoin's price slipped below the $80,000 mark following news that US inflation reached 3.8%. This higher-than-expected inflation data has reduced market expectations for imminent interest rate cuts, contributing to a risk-off sentiment in cryptocurrency markets.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K as US Inflation Hits 3.8%, Dampening Rate Cut Hopes

details: XRP has shown a rebound, with its price trading above $1.46 after testing support at $1.42. This recovery is attributed to easing selling pressure, positive technical alignments, and inflows into XRP-related ETFs, suggesting a potential breakout above $1.50.
title: XRP Rebounds Amid ETF Inflows and Positive Funding

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy may acquire over 3,000 BTC this week, potentially propelling Bitcoin towards a $100,000 valuation in Q2. The renewed buying capacity of Strategy, coupled with declining stablecoin dominance, suggests a return of liquidity to the broader crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Targets $100K in Q2 as Strategy's Buying Power Rises
